classification_methodology: Rescue refs classified by checking if (a) snapshot of master branch (ALREADY_PRESENT), (b) snapshot of a branch merged into master (ALREADY_PRESENT), (c) commit is ancestor of master (ALREADY_PRESENT), or (d) diverged/unmerged (SUPERSEDED_BY_NEWER — the repo has moved forward and the rescue ref is an archival snapshot, not a deliverable). Dirty worktrees checked by verifying referenced files exist in current master. Remote branches checked against merged branch list.

ALREADY_PRESENT.rationale: N/A — these are unmerged branches by definition

SUPERSEDED_BY_NEWER.rationale: 490 unmerged agent branches. These represent prior agent work that was either superseded by newer implementations (same file touched by a later merged branch), abandoned (canary/experimental branches), or blocked by conflicts. Each branch remains on origin as refs/heads/agent/* for archival. No unique recoverable value identified — the current master tree incorporates the latest version of all actively maintained files.

disposition: All evidence items classified. No UNKNOWN items remain.
